status: proposed planning catalogue; not a runtime mission format

cards.name: Cell relay
cards.decision: Choose a route and coordinate a replaceable pair of carriers.
cards.recovery: Safely park/release the unique cell; replace a carrier and use a validated manual hatch route.
cards.public_evidence: Cell location and seated/power state; no allegiance facts.

cards.name: Cargo inspection
cards.decision: Decide whether and how to share a narrow case property.
cards.recovery: A slower public physical inspection identifies the restricted core when a scanner is unavailable.
cards.public_evidence: Inspected case property with source and scope; not the inspector's role.

cards.name: Medical reserve
cards.decision: Deliver an optional medical kit or retain it for a mobile rescue.
cards.recovery: Basic bounded medical recovery remains available without completing the delivery.
cards.public_evidence: Delivered supply state; no global player injury tracking.

cards.name: Coolant bypass
cards.decision: Choose a repair approach after station power returns.
cards.recovery: Authoritative progress survives handover; slower manual completion avoids a unique-tool veto.
cards.public_evidence: Local repair progress and public completion state.

cards.name: Door bus repair
cards.decision: Restore convenient credential access or tolerate slower manual routing.
cards.recovery: Timed manual override and tested alternate paths remain available.
cards.public_evidence: Door service state; no complete player movement history.

cards.name: Relay alignment
cards.decision: Restore the common radio while preserving local coordination.
cards.recovery: Proximity and contextual pings remain supported; technical loss has separate feedback.
cards.public_evidence: Common radio service status; no inferred speaker intent.
